北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京霾天，体感较凉 4℃，出门请做好防护。
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is hazy and feels cool at 4℃. Please take precautions outdoors.

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天，气温 21℃，体感舒适，注意防晒哦。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy with a comfortable 21℃. Remember sun protection.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阳光明媚 19℃，体感舒适，正是出游好时光。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is sunny and pleasant at 19℃. A great time to be out!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天 21℃，湿度 72%，可能有些闷热，注意补水。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy at 21℃ with 72% humidity; it might feel a bit muggy. Stay hydrated!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云 23℃，体感暖和，湿度适中，记得多喝水。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is partly cloudy and warm at 23℃. Moderate humidity, remember to drink water.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州晴朗 20℃，体感宜人，别忘了享受阳光！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is sunny and pleasant at 20℃. Don't forget to enjoy the sunshine!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天 16℃，体感微凉，记得添衣保暖。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy and slightly cool at 16℃. Remember to dress warmly.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天 12℃，湿度 73%，感觉有点湿冷，多穿点哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy and damp at 12℃. It might feel chilly, so dress warmly.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉多云 20℃，体感舒适，傍晚注意温差。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is partly cloudy and pleasant at 20℃. Be mindful of temperature changes in the evening.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗 13℃，体感略凉，空气干燥，多补水。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny and slightly cool at 13℃. Air is dry, so hydrate well.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆有雾 14℃，能见度低，外出注意交通安全。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is foggy at 14℃. Low visibility, so be careful when traveling.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨有雾 3℃，体感寒冷，风力较大，务必多穿。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is foggy at 3℃, feeling very cold with strong winds. Dress very warmly.

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳阴天 8℃，体感寒凉，风力较大，注意防风保暖。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy at 8℃, feeling cold with strong winds. Keep warm and protected from wind.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴朗 15℃，体感舒适，户外活动别忘了防晒。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny and pleasant at 15℃. Don't forget sun protection for outdoor activities.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门有雾 16℃，湿度很高，注意路滑和潮湿。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is foggy at 16℃ with high humidity. Watch out for slippery roads and dampness.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛大雾 12℃，湿度 90%，能见度低，出行小心。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is very foggy at 12℃ with 90% humidity. Low visibility, travel carefully.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连有雾 9℃，能见度差，出行请注意安全。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is foggy at 9℃ with poor visibility. Please take care when traveling.
